lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: You made it. That matters more than it used to.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Mechara is still scarred by the Collapse.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Every settlement left standing survives

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: because someone keeps growing stronger than what waits outside the walls.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Ironhaven does not need another drifter.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: It needs someone who can learn the frontier, sharpen a crew, and stand between this town

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: and whatever comes for it next.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Start by speaking with the people here.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: See what Ironhaven is holding together, and what it will ask of you.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: You've seen enough now to understand the shape of it.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: We have held on through bad odds, failing machines, and years of making do with less than we needed.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: What Ironhaven needs next is a crew willing to push the frontier back instead of waiting for it to come

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: to us.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Good. Now you know what this place is trying to protect.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Speak with Mira next.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: She knows the frontier better than anyone here,

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: and she does not waste time on crews that cannot hold their ground.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Earn her trust, and the real work begins.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: So Bram finally sent you my way.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Good. Then listen carefully: the frontier does not care what potential you have.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: It only cares whether you and your crew can survive what it puts in front of you.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Verdant Fields is the first stretch out from Ironhaven.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Go out through the east gate and you'll hit the live frontier fast.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Take your crew out there. Hold the line. Come back standing, and then we can talk about what comes next.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Back in one piece. Good.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: That means you listened, and your crew did not fold the moment the frontier pushed back.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Now we move from survival to footholds.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Claim a patch of the frontier, put down storage, and learn how to bank supplies away from town.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: If you can do that, you can hold ground instead of just borrowing it.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Once you've done it, come back to me. Then we'll talk about Shadow Caves.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Good. Now you've done more than survive.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: You claimed ground, built a foothold, and proved you can bring frontier haul home through your own line.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Shadow Caves is next. That is where a foothold turns into leverage.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Take this Workshop Pass, get into the caves, and find the Luminous Shard.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Bring it back to me, and I'll stabilize the lift to Dragon Peak. Bring back proof that Ironhaven can push farther than the fields.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: You felt it out there. We felt it here.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: The moment Shadow Caves opened, Ironhaven stopped acting like a town staring at the frontier and started acting like one that could answer it.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Hale has the depot running. Vesa is keeping claims and salvage moving through the annex. That whole east gate road exists because you held the line long enough for us to build behind you.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Keep doing that, and this settlement will become something the old world would recognize.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: If you want to see what the annex needs next, speak with Hale at the depot counter. He'll tell you how to keep this new line fed.

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: A new annex is easy to cheer for. Harder to keep fed.

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: Bring back one more real haul from the frontier and bank it here. I want the crew to feel the route, the sorting, and the turnaround while it's still small enough to learn.

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: Once the depot has handled a live resupply, come find me again.

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: That did it. The annex crew has a rhythm now instead of a pile.

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: Fresh haul in, sorted stock out, claims logged, repairs moving. That's how Ironhaven stops reacting to the frontier and starts shaping it.

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: Keep feeding the line and we'll make this gate road feel like the center of a real campaign.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: The Forge Core finally has enough charge to do more than keep Ironhaven breathing.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Now we turn survival into capability.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Silas is taking over the alloy work, Rex is drilling proper response lines, and Professor Cogs is building an archive out of everything we've dragged home from the frontier.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Meet each of them. Act 2 begins when Ironhaven learns how to use what you've won.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: Lv2 power means real foundry work.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: Not patch jobs. Not survival scrap.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: Bring me better alloy stock and design fragments and I'll turn your crew into something the frontier has to respect.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: A bigger roster means nothing if it fights like a panic line.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: The training ground and command rail are what turn survivors into a force.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: Get stronger. Get coordinated. Then push where the old walls were never enough.

lines.speaker: Professor Cogs
lines.text: At last, somewhere to put all this frontier noise.

lines.speaker: Professor Cogs
lines.text: Scans, route drift, ruin harmonics, recovered design fragments.

lines.speaker: Professor Cogs
lines.text: Bring me more, and the archive will stop being a ledger and start becoming an advantage.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Good. Ironhaven finally has the shape of a real command town.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Craft harder. Recruit smarter. Build a team the next frontier line can't break.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: That is how we survive what comes after the mountain.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: There it is. Clean resonance, stable core, no fracture bloom.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Once I tune this shard, the peak lift will answer your sigil.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Take these supplies and keep climbing. Dragon Peak is ready for you now.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: The pass will get you through the cave gate.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Find the Luminous Shard, and keep an eye out for old scout caches while you're in there.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: Your crew is moving like it understands the work now.

lines.speaker: Mira
lines.text: The lift to Dragon Peak should answer the sigil I tuned for you.

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: Mira's pass should get you into the caves.

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: Once you're inside, keep right at the broken pillars. The left route collapses more often than it holds.

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: That's how it starts.

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: One route opens, then another, and before you know it the whole frontier has a different shape.

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: Keep one eye on your party order and the other on the sky.

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: Bram wants the watchtower online? Good. Take these alignment notes back to him.

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: Once the lamps are synced, we can start seeing farther than the gate.

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: One of the watchtower crates held an intact Artificer frame.

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: It isn't fit for the line yet, but it can travel with you if you want to bring it online.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Mira is right to hold the lift.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Until the cave shard is secured, Dragon Peak stays closed.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: The mountain lift is humming again.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: When you're ready, Dragon Peak is waiting.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: I saw a strange cache deeper in the cave.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: It was tucked beyond the central pillar, where the passage forks east.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: That glow in your pack means you found the cache.

lines.speaker: Scout
lines.text: Head back before the tunnels decide to shift on you.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Dragon Peak is running on fumes.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Search the ridge for a Sun Core,

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: and we'll relight the old warding pylons before the mountain goes dark for good.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Perfect. The Sun Core is stable.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Take this reward and keep pushing outward.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: The whole frontier is starting to wake up.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: The Sun Core should be stashed past the wind-broken ridge.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Take the eastern path once the trail starts narrowing.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: You've done more than reopen a lift.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: The frontier feels alive again.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: This is the kind of salvage I needed to see.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: You brought it back instead of burning through it in the field. That's how Ironhaven keeps anything running.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: I already pulled a restored tool crate out by the workshop wall. Crack it open and I can bring the line back online.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: Survey cradle's half buried, but not dead.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: Give me a minute and I'll kick it back online.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: Tell Nia the drones are hers again.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: If you find old parts in the wild, bring them here.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: I can usually make something useful out of them.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Travelers leave rumors behind.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: One of them says there's a buried vault east of town.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Start with the herbalist's walls.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: So the rumor was true.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Good crews always test the hidden seams of a place.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Now that the peak relays are live again, I can chart farther routes.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Toma just needs someone to kick the old survey drone cradle back awake.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: The survey drones are airborne again.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: That means safer routes, cleaner supply calls, and one less blind frontier.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Travelers leave rumors behind.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Keep listening.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Rest when you can.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Even machines need a rhythm.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: With the lift alive again, we can finally power the old watchtower.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Tor still has the alignment notes if you're willing to carry them over.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: That's the last of it.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: The watchtower lamps are online again, and Ironhaven won't feel quite so small tonight.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: Hidden chests react to careful eyes.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: Walk close and watch the outline flicker.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: And if you find an intact medic frame, I'll patch it into your crew.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: There. The support frame is stable again.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: It will follow your commands from here on out.

lines.speaker: Iris
lines.text: Hidden chests react to careful eyes. Walk close and watch the outline flicker.

lines.speaker: Ranger Pell
lines.text: The roots around the Moonlit Glade shift every dusk.

lines.speaker: Ranger Pell
lines.text: If you can map the pattern with a scan frame, we might finally reclaim the clearing.

lines.speaker: Ranger Pell
lines.text: Follow the roots that hum back at your scanner.

lines.speaker: Ranger Pell
lines.text: The glade should open if the pattern is traced cleanly.

lines.speaker: Ranger Pell
lines.text: So the glade was real after all.

lines.speaker: Ranger Pell
lines.text: Good. One less forgotten place sealed off by fear and old growth.

lines.speaker: Ranger Pell
lines.text: Whispering Forest keeps its paths for crews that pay attention.

lines.speaker: Jora
lines.text: The quarry's jammed sluice is blocking a maintenance lane full of salvage.

lines.speaker: Jora
lines.text: If your heavy frame can wrench it loose, the whole lift route gets easier to trust.

lines.speaker: Jora
lines.text: The sluice sits just past the crusher line.

lines.speaker: Jora
lines.text: You'll need a real vanguard shove to break it free.

lines.speaker: Jora
lines.text: There it is.

lines.speaker: Jora
lines.text: Air moving through the lane again. That's what progress sounds like in a quarry.

lines.speaker: Jora
lines.text: Every cleared machine lane becomes a road for the people after us.

lines.speaker: Captain Maren
lines.text: The drowned archive below still carries intact charts.

lines.speaker: Captain Maren
lines.text: Bring me whatever route key survived down there,

lines.speaker: Captain Maren
lines.text: and I can point you toward the old command skies.

lines.speaker: Captain Maren
lines.text: Search the Archive Hull.

lines.speaker: Captain Maren
lines.text: The chart capsule should still be sealed against pressure and corrosion.

lines.speaker: Captain Maren
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: Captain Maren
lines.text: This Archive Chart marks an air route the old world used to reach the fortress above the clouds.

lines.speaker: Captain Maren
lines.text: Take it. The sky path is yours now.

lines.speaker: Captain Maren
lines.text: The sea keeps memories longer than the frontier does.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: The fortress rails still answer a proper command token.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: If the sanctum below the clouds still holds one,

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: recover it and we'll reopen the deepest routes.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: Clockwork Sanctum should still be preserving command hardware.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: Search the resonance vaults.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: That's it.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: With the Command Sigil back online, the fortress no longer feels like a dead shell.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: The final rails are opening.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: The old command lattice was built for war.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: We'll use it to rebuild routes instead.

lines.speaker: Clockmaker Echo
lines.text: A final key remains outside the machine's own logic.

lines.speaker: Clockmaker Echo
lines.text: Search the Abyssal Rift.

lines.speaker: Clockmaker Echo
lines.text: Only the Void Key can separate memory from collapse.

lines.speaker: Clockmaker Echo
lines.text: At the edge of the rift, the world forgets its own shape.

lines.speaker: Clockmaker Echo
lines.text: That is where the key was hidden.

lines.speaker: Clockmaker Echo
lines.text: The Void Key has returned to the world of form.

lines.speaker: Clockmaker Echo
lines.text: The final conduit is stable enough for a Forge Master to pass.

lines.speaker: Clockmaker Echo
lines.text: Time is only another machine until it breaks.

lines.speaker: The Watcher
lines.text: You have the key, the route, and the will.

lines.speaker: The Watcher
lines.text: Step into the final silence.

lines.speaker: The Watcher
lines.text: Memory Lane waits, and beyond it, Origin.

lines.speaker: The Watcher
lines.text: Every repaired road ends where memory begins.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: The herbalist swears there's a sealed cache behind those resin-thorns east of town.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Burn through them cleanly and we'll see what the old frontier hid there.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Don't hack at the brambles.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Heat the resin, let it peel back, and the cache should sit just beyond the wall.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Perfect. The old cache was real, and now we've got one more secret route back under our control.

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: There's an old trailhead past the southern hedge, but a collapsed boulder sealed it months ago.

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: If one of your heavy frames can shift it, we get another safe line out of Ironhaven.

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: The boulder is packed into the trail deeper than it looks. Hit it with pure leverage, not finesse.

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: That does it. One more route open, one less blind corner around town.

lines.speaker: Tor
lines.text: That's how a frontier starts feeling like a home again.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: There's a shimmer wall deeper in the cave.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: It answers every scanner pulse differently.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Trace the seam for me and we may finally map the hollow behind it.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: Watch for the wall to flicker back in rhythm with your scan lattice.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: That's where the seam opens.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: A hidden passage and a clean scan trace.

lines.speaker: Rhea
lines.text: That's the kind of map work that keeps crews alive down here.

lines.speaker: Reno
lines.text: The shallows are lying to me.

lines.speaker: Reno
lines.text: There's a hidden current threading between the rocks.

lines.speaker: Reno
lines.text: I need a scan frame to chart it without losing a whole salvage skiff.

lines.speaker: Reno
lines.text: Follow the drift where the foam cuts sideways.

lines.speaker: Reno
lines.text: If the scanner holds, the tidepool should open on the far shelf.

lines.speaker: Reno
lines.text: That's the line.

lines.speaker: Reno
lines.text: With that tidepool route mapped, we can pull salvage without feeding another barge to the surf.

lines.speaker: Professor Lio
lines.text: These crystal harmonics are close to Dragon Peak's warding frequencies,

lines.speaker: Professor Lio
lines.text: but not close enough.

lines.speaker: Professor Lio
lines.text: Take my notes to Edda and ask how the pylons stayed stable at altitude.

lines.speaker: Professor Lio
lines.text: Edda will know which harmonics to trim.

lines.speaker: Professor Lio
lines.text: The mountain learned stability the hard way.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Lio's close.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: Tell him to damp the third harmonic, then bias the core toward the colder crystal lines.

lines.speaker: Edda
lines.text: That should keep the vault from singing itself apart.

lines.speaker: Professor Lio
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: Professor Lio
lines.text: Edda trimmed the instability exactly where I feared it.

lines.speaker: Professor Lio
lines.text: With this, the depths become a laboratory again instead of a warning.

lines.speaker: Sister Vale
lines.text: The cloister's prayer circuit was really a machine lattice.

lines.speaker: Sister Vale
lines.text: If the Clockmaker Echo still remembers its pattern,

lines.speaker: Sister Vale
lines.text: we may be able to wake the vale without breaking it.

lines.speaker: Clockmaker Echo
lines.text: The cloister ran on a closed winter loop.

lines.speaker: Clockmaker Echo
lines.text: Tell the pilgrim to restart it slowly, one ring at a time.

lines.speaker: Clockmaker Echo
lines.text: Let the frost keep the timing honest.

lines.speaker: Sister Vale
lines.text: Then the old circuit still has purpose.

lines.speaker: Sister Vale
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: Sister Vale
lines.text: Even frozen places deserve a pulse strong enough to answer winter.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: Scorched Plateau teaches fast.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: Volcanic Core teaches once.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: Take my heat-tolerance specs to Kira.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: I need something we can actually build around before I send our people into that furnace.

lines.speaker: Forgehand Kira
lines.text: Toma is forcing the plateau alloy too hard.

lines.speaker: Forgehand Kira
lines.text: Tell him to temper the plates twice.

lines.speaker: Forgehand Kira
lines.text: Then quench them in slagwater, not ash.

lines.speaker: Forgehand Kira
lines.text: Do that, and the frames will bend before they shatter.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: So that's the accord.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: Plateau grit. Core heat. A process that won't kill the crew using it.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: That's not theory anymore.

lines.speaker: Toma
lines.text: That's Ironhaven getting stronger.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: The command rails are awake again.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: Problem is, they're still carrying ghost traffic from the old war lattice.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: One bad pulse and we lose another control hub.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: Find the Clockmaker Echo.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: If anyone knows how to silence dead signals, it's that machine.

lines.speaker: Clockmaker Echo
lines.text: The rails are still listening for a conductor who died centuries ago.

lines.speaker: Clockmaker Echo
lines.text: Tell Rex to pulse them in threes.

lines.speaker: Clockmaker Echo
lines.text: Then cut the fourth beat short.

lines.speaker: Clockmaker Echo
lines.text: The old command ghosts will chase the missing rhythm and collapse into silence.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: Good.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: The rail lattice is stable, and the fortress is still standing.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: That's a better outcome than most pre-collapse repairs give us.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: Now we can use these lines like builders.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: Not grave robbers.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: The pylons are back online.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: That means the routes beyond Dragon Peak are no longer completely blind.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Push out into the midlands and tell me what's actually out there.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: So the midlands are alive — and hostile in ways we didn't expect.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Good to know before we send supply runs through.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Nia's been picking up something strange from the deep water zones.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: You should hear it from her directly.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: The survey drones caught a pulse from the deep water zones.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Rhythmic. Stable. Not natural.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Something down there is still running.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Head to the Coastal Shallows and trace it closer to the source.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: The pulse is definitely below the shallows.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Once you reach the deep shelf, your scanner should start separating the signal from the current.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: When it does, follow the strongest variance.

lines.speaker: Nia
lines.text: Whatever's down there is still transmitting on purpose.

lines.speaker: Captain Maren
lines.text: A pulse from the deep shelf?

lines.speaker: Captain Maren
lines.text: I know what that is.

lines.speaker: Captain Maren
lines.text: There's a drowned archive below. I mapped the approach once, years ago.

lines.speaker: Captain Maren
lines.text: If that signal is still live, then the archive is still intact. We need what's inside.

lines.speaker: Bolt Simulation
lines.text: Welcome back, challenger.

lines.speaker: Bolt Simulation
lines.text: Every ten floors, the dungeon answers with a harsher test.

lines.speaker: Bolt Simulation
lines.text: Every return trip is another proof.

lines.speaker: Bolt Simulation
lines.text: Show me what mastery looks like.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: A forge tells the truth faster than people do.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: It sings when the metal is right.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: It screams when the work is sloppy.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: Bring me salvage and I'll show you the difference.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: The basic rails are humming again.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: That's enough for repairs.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: Not enough for the kind of parts your crew will need next.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: Give me the backing to retool the alloy chambers.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: Then we'll start building for the frontier, not just surviving it.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: The alloy work proved something.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: That old fusion cradle in the back can be restored.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: Most people think fusion is brute force.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: It isn't.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: It's craft.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: The fusion cradle is running.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: Bring me two compatible frames.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: The machine will decide what survives the joining.

lines.speaker: Master Silas
lines.text: Our job is to be wise enough to choose what goes in.

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: Patching armor is easy.

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: Keeping a team battle-ready is harder.

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: If your crew looks worn, bring them to me before the next sortie.

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: The shelves are full enough for more than emergency care now.

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: Let me build proper field kits.

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: Better potions. Better recovery. Fewer retreats that end in panic.

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: Your team will feel the difference out in the field.

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: The frontier is bringing back materials I've never had the chance to study.

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: If I can isolate them safely, I can do more than heal damage.

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: I can change how your team fights.

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: Give me the lab space and I'll prove it.

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: The compound lab is stable.

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: Some of these formulas are older than Ironhaven itself.

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: I'm still learning what they were made to cure.

lines.speaker: Elena
lines.text: And what they were made to become.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: Ironhaven's walls don't hold because they're tall.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: They hold because people chose to stay and fight for them.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: Don't let that choice count for nothing out there.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: The watchtower sees farther now.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: But relay coverage still dies at the ridgeline.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: Give me the resources to extend it.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: Then we'll have eyes on every major approach to Ironhaven.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: Relay coverage gives us reach.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: A command hub gives us control.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: Coordination. Rapid response. Tactical routing.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: Ironhaven stops being a waypoint and becomes a real stronghold.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: The hub is operational.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: Every field unit we send out now has a real command structure behind it.

lines.speaker: Commander Rex
lines.text: That changes what Ironhaven is capable of.

lines.speaker: Professor Cogs
lines.text: Every battle logged is data.

lines.speaker: Professor Cogs
lines.text: Every disaster survived is a dissertation.

lines.speaker: Professor Cogs
lines.text: Keep fighting.

lines.speaker: Professor Cogs
lines.text: I'll keep learning.

lines.speaker: Professor Cogs
lines.text: The survey drones are doing their job too well.

lines.speaker: Professor Cogs
lines.text: They're feeding us more raw data than we can sort.

lines.speaker: Professor Cogs
lines.text: Without proper vaults, we're drowning in noise.

lines.speaker: Professor Cogs
lines.text: Bring me 3 Settlement Plan Fragments.

lines.speaker: Professor Cogs
lines.text: I'll turn the noise into knowledge.

lines.speaker: Professor Cogs
lines.text: The vaults gave me the patterns I needed.

lines.speaker: Professor Cogs
lines.text: And those patterns point to a design space standard forging never reaches.

lines.speaker: Professor Cogs
lines.text: Bring me 4 Forge Schema Fragments.

lines.speaker: Professor Cogs
lines.text: I'll show you what the frontier was really trying to build before it fell.

lines.speaker: Professor Cogs
lines.text: The prototype lab is running.

lines.speaker: Professor Cogs
lines.text: And what I'm seeing in the foundry data could rewrite everything we thought we knew about pre-collapse engineering.

lines.speaker: Professor Cogs
lines.text: That is either thrilling or deeply alarming.

lines.speaker: Bolt
lines.text: A Forge Master with your record?

lines.speaker: Bolt
lines.text: Yeah, I've been waiting for you.

lines.speaker: Bolt
lines.text: The dungeon's calling if you're ready for a real test.

lines.speaker: Bolt
lines.text: Now that the command hub is online, I can track your runs properly.

lines.speaker: Bolt
lines.text: Every ten floors, expect the parameters to shift.

lines.speaker: Bolt
lines.text: Don't worry.

lines.speaker: Bolt
lines.text: I'll be watching.

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: If it's broken, lost, or forgotten, I can usually smell where it ended up.

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: And if I can't?

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: Give me a day and a decent offer.

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: There's a sealed supply cache in the quarry's lower lane.

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: Old enough that even Jora doesn't know what's inside.

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: Help me crack it open.

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: We split whatever survives the seal.

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: Quarry lower lane, past the sluice.

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: The cache uses a triple-lock seal.

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: Your scanner should be able to read the combination from the corrosion pattern.

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: Pre-collapse salvage.

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: Barely touched by the weather, too.

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: That's a good pull, partner.

lines.speaker: Jax
lines.text: Let's call this the start of a profitable friendship.

lines.speaker: Kira
lines.text: The forge doesn't care about rank.

lines.speaker: Kira
lines.text: Only heat. Patience. And whether your hands shake when the metal starts to glow.

lines.speaker: Kira
lines.text: Mine don't.

lines.speaker: Kira
lines.text: After the plateau accord, I finally had enough good material to build a proper Ironhaven smithy.

lines.speaker: Kira
lines.text: If Silas wants heat work done right, he knows where to find me.

lines.speaker: Kira
lines.text: And if he doesn't ask nicely, I'll remind him.

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: Shadow Caves cracked the east line wide open.

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: Bram wanted the salvage to stop piling up in the square, so now the annex takes it first, sorts it fast, and sends it where Ironhaven needs it.

lines.speaker: Hale
lines.text: Bring back enough field haul and this whole gate road will turn into a real frontier quarter.

lines.speaker: Vesa
lines.text: Every outpost report used to die in a loose stack on Bram's table.

lines.speaker: Vesa
lines.text: Now we have route ledgers, salvage tallies, and proper claim records moving through the annex.

lines.speaker: Vesa
lines.text: Hold more ground out there and Ironhaven gets sharper in here. That's the deal.
